name: Counter-Strike 2
description: Counter-Strike 2 dedicated server (Steam app 730), installed and updated with SteamCMD. The download is large: allow about 60 GB of disk and at least 4 GB of memory. A Game Server Login Token is needed for the server to be listed publicly.
startup_command: export HOME=/home/container; export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="/home/container/game/bin/linuxsteamrt64:${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-}"; ./game/bin/linuxsteamrt64/cs2 -dedicated -ip 0.0.0.0 -port {{SERVER_PORT}} -tv_port {{TV_PORT}} -maxplayers {{MAX_PLAYERS}} -usercon $( [ "${VAC_ENABLED}" = "1" ] || [ "${VAC_ENABLED}" = "true" ] || printf %s '-insecure' ) +game_type {{GAME_TYPE}} +game_mode {{GAME_MODE}} +map {{SRCDS_MAP}} +hostname "${SERVER_NAME}" $( [ -n "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ] && printf '+sv_password %s' "${SERVER_PASSWORD}" ) $( [ -n "${RCON_PASSWORD}" ] && printf '+rcon_password %s' "${RCON_PASSWORD}" ) $( [ -n "${STEAM_TOKEN}" ] && printf '+sv_setsteamaccount %s' "${STEAM_TOKEN}" )

variables.name: Map
variables.description: Map the server starts on, for example de_dust2, de_mirage, de_inferno, de_nuke, de_ancient, de_anubis, cs_office or ar_baggage.

variables.name: Game Type
variables.description: Sets the game together with Game Mode. Type 0 with mode 0 is Casual, 0/1 Competitive, 0/2 Wingman, 1/0 Arms Race, 1/2 Deathmatch, 3/0 Custom.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: Sets the game together with Game Type. The defaults (type 0, mode 1) give Competitive.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: Highest number of players that can be connected at once.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Name shown in the server browser. Double quotes are not allowed.

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Password players need to join. Leave empty for an open server.

variables.name: RCON Password
variables.description: Password for remote console tools, which connect to the game port over TCP. Leave empty to keep RCON disabled.

variables.name: Game Server Login Token
variables.description: 32 character token (GSLT) for app 730 from https://steamcommunity.com/dev/managegameservers. Without it the server is not listed publicly and players may only be able to join from the local network or by direct connect.

variables.name: Valve Anti-Cheat
variables.description: Protect the server with VAC. Turning it off starts the server with -insecure.

variables.name: Update On Start
variables.description: Check Steam for a server update every time the server starts. Turn it off to start faster or to stay on the installed build.

variables.name: Steam App ID
variables.description: Steam app id of the dedicated server. Used by the installer and by the update on start; do not change it.
